what_this_is: The ticket economy for FED-EDU physical raffles. Every way to earn raffle tickets, in plain numbers. This is the same economy the leaderboard tallies nightly (leaderboard_sync.yml) and the same currency the hustle-index commissions pay out.

the_prize_ladder.why: The rung-2 machine: real keyboard, real screen, VS Code at full speed. Brother ships the phone-only rung, wins the rig, the rig compounds.
the_prize_ladder.typical_specs: Refurb business tower: i5-class CPU, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD, fresh Linux or Windows. Not a gaming rig — a WORK rig. Perfect for this curriculum.
the_prize_ladder.shipping: assets/safe-shipping-checklist.md — the checklist governs every shipment. Address privacy is law.

the_prize_ladder.why: The mobile rung-2: tether anywhere, ship anywhere. For the brother whose situation doesn't hold a desk.
the_prize_ladder.typical_specs: Refurb business laptop: i5-class, 8GB, 256GB SSD, battery tested above 80% health.

the_prize_ladder.why: For the phone-only brothers: a quality USB-C cable that doesn't fail the seven taps (EasyTether course lesson 2), a phone stand, a small Bluetooth keyboard for serious typing sessions.
the_prize_ladder.typical_specs: Anker-grade cable + folding stand + compact keyboard. The kit that makes the phone rung feel real.

the_prize_ladder.why: Metered data is the real tax on the phone-only brother. A $25 data card buys a month of tethered lessons.
the_prize_ladder.typical_specs: $25 prepaid carrier card (winner's carrier, winner's country where possible — the diaspora map governs).
the_prize_ladder.shipping: digital delivery — no address needed, same privacy law.

pr_merged.note: Any PR merged to the main repo. Docs fix, code fix, new term in the urban dictionary — merged is merged.

guide_completed.note: A course or guide completed with the receipts posted (monitor screenshot per the course READMEs).

blueprint_rung_shipped.note: A sandbox blueprint rung shipped and vouched by a brother. The big-ticket item — rungs are real projects.

bug_with_receipts.note: A bug reported with error text, steps, and rig profile — the receipts pattern from the debug_helper prompt.

commission_paid.note: A hustle-index commission delivered and PAID. Client money moved into a Black household — that's the mission.

repeat_client.note: A client who comes back. The repeat is the proof the work was worth the floor.

vouching.note: Vouching for another brother's showcase entry. Witnessing receipts is work — the vault runs on vouches.

mail_in_lesson.note: Inside-the-system brothers: a completed mail-in lesson unit (the diaspora map's incarcerated hub). Time served on the skill.

the_rules: Tickets are non-transferable. You can't gift, sell, or pool tickets. Your grind is your grind — no ticket markets.
Self-reported tickets get vouched or they don't count. One brother's vouch, posted in the thread, is the receipt.
The draw is public math on public data (raffle-logic.js). The seed publishes with the winner. Any brother can re-run the draw and verify.
Winning a tower doesn't remove you from laptop raffles — but a brother can only win ONE machine per year. Spread the rigs.
No purchase necessary. There is NO way to buy tickets. This is not a lottery — it's a receipts economy. The mission is skill, the raffle is the on-ramp.

Address privacy: shipping goes through the checklist. Addresses live nowhere in this repo — ever. The brother sends his address through fed-comm-dm encrypted DM, it goes straight to the shipper, and it's deleted after the label prints.
Under-18 winners ship to a guardian address, with the guardian cc'd. Protecting the young kings is law.
the_math_note: Odds are published before every draw: your tickets / total pool tickets. A brother with 38 tickets in a 58-ticket pool holds a 65.5% shot — but the brother with 8 tickets can still win, and has. That's the point of a raffle over a leaderboard: the little brother's ticket is REAL. The grind improves the odds; the draw respects the ticket.
the_honest_limit: Raffle frequency depends on funding (support-the-block Ko-fi). Prizes ship when the fund covers them — the fund balance publishes with every raffle announcement. No silent delays: if the fund runs thin, the community hears it straight, and the hustle-index commissions keep moving regardless. The skill economy never pauses; the prize ladder flexes with the fund.
